title: UPTET 2026 Online Correction/ Edit Form: for Primary & Junior Level Teacher Eligibility Test #UPTET2026 #UPTETForm2026 #UPTETExamDate #UPTeacherEligibility #SarkariNaukri
intro: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test UPTET 2026 Exam.   Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to UPTET 2026 Exam. Online Apply Start On March 27, 2026 & Last Date for Application is May 3, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Notification Issue : 20 March 2026
Online Apply Start On : 27 March 2026
Registration Last Date : 03 May 2026
Fee Payment Last Date : 03 May 2026
Correction Last Date : 08 May 2026
Exam City Details Available : 22 June 2026
Admit Card Available : 30 June 2026
Exam Date : 02 to 04 July 2026
General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates : Rs. 1000/-
SC/ ST Candidates : Rs. 500/-
PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, SBI I Collect , SBI E Challan Submit Fee in Any SBI Branch.
Bachelor Degree from a recognized University / College and 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education (DELED / BTC) passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree from a recognized University / College and 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education (Special Education) passed or appearing in final year OR

Bachelor Degree from a recognized University / College with 2 Year BTC / Urdu BTC passed or appearing in final year from an institution recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) / Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 50% Marks and B.Ed passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 45% Marks and B.Ed passed or appearing in final year, as per NCTE norms OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with B.Ed (Special Education) passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with BTC Urdu 2 Year Training passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with Diploma in Teaching from Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with Moallim-e-Urdu degree from Aligarh Muslim University, completed before 11 August 1997 OR
Candidates with 10+2 Intermediate and at least 50% Marks along with 4 Year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) passed or appearing in final year are also eligible.
For full details, candidates should check the official UPTET Primary Level Eligibility 2026 notification.
Bachelor Degree from a recognized University / College and 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education (DELED / BTC) passed or appearing in final year from an institution recognized by NCTE OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 50% Marks and B.Ed passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 45% Marks and B.Ed passed or appearing in final year, as per NCTE norms and current guidelines OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 50% Marks and B.Ed (Special Education) passed or appearing in final year from an institution recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) OR
Senior Secondary / Intermediate with at least 50% Marks and 4 Year B.A. B.Ed / B.Sc. B.Ed passed or appearing in final year OR
Senior Secondary / Intermediate with at least 50% Marks and 4 Year B.El.Ed / B.A. B.Ed / B.Sc. B.Ed passed or appearing in final year OR
Senior Secondary / Intermediate with at least 50% Marks and 4 Year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) passed or appearing in final year OR
Bachelor Degree / Master Degree with at least 50% Marks and 1 Year B.Ed (Special Education) passed or appearing in final year from an institution recognized by RCI.
For full details, candidates should check the official UPTET Junior Level Eligibility 2026 notification.
UPTET 2026 Primary Level is for Class 1 to 5 teacher eligibility.
UPTET 2026 Junior Level is for Class 6 to 8 teacher eligibility.
Both papers will contain 150 MCQs carrying 150 marks.
Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
The official notice shown here does not mention negative marking.
Read the official UPTET 2026 notification for complete syllabus and subject-wise details.

Selection: Qualifying Exam (60% marks to qualify), no direct recruitment.

UP Govt Teacher Job: Gateway to Primary/Junior Teacher posts in Uttar Pradesh.
